answer: Because the horizon audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, which means paying the tundra bond on all of them and exposing each to the marble slash. Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 2 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm of 247 pays that 199 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
